implementation_policy: The phone is an ABD rigid body and the middle sofa cushion a Stable Neo-Hookean tetrahedral FEM solid with Newton-coupled Kelvin-Voigt viscosity (E 1 kPa, nu 0.15, 35 kg/m^3), coupled by IPC contact in libuipc 0.0.28 (CUDA, BDF1, dt 1/1200 s, gravity 5 m/s^2, fixed contact stiffness), each case starting from its own settled equilibrium; the removed-cushion edit is a PyBullet 6-DoF rigid solve on the upholstered deck at 4800 Hz, and the added pillow is a second FEM body. Each edit changes one declared physical parameter (DELETE cushion, ADD pillow preset, cushion E x100 / x0.5, phone mass x10); no pose or trajectory is authored. The registered 0-4 s caches come from re-running every case's original solver from t = 0 to 4 s with all physical settings unchanged, only the 3 s duration guard raised to 4 s (states at 240 Hz). Blender 4.3.2 replays those states in the packed scenes (cushion through fixed tetrahedral shape functions, phone as keyed rigid transforms) on a 24 FPS clock, appearance/realism_look.py applies the current look (closed room lit by sun and sky through the window, scanned materials, no logos, a plain dual-camera module), appearance/cushion_smoothing.py smooths the rendered cushion around the phone and keeps it out of the phone body (render only; caches and ground truth unchanged), Cycles renders 1280x720 frames and the builder encodes, writes ground truth from the solver states and publishes the suite.

runtimes.python: python3 (standard library) for verify/package; .venv-rigid-elastic for ground truth (numpy) and physics

solver_rerun: none in this repository: the original solver producers and their inputs are not included; the registered 0-4 s caches are the reproduction inputs
